title: Replace the car, smartly
tagline: Compare keeping, replacing, electric, leasing or sharing, with financing and insurance in one go.
trigger: Garage bills on an ageing car keep rising, or a car lease is ending.

steps.title: What your car really costs
steps.description: Fuel, repairs, insurance and depreciation from your own payments, compared with an electric car, a lease and car sharing.
steps.why: KBC already sees your fuel, garage and insurance payments.
steps.result: Your car costs about €{car_monthly} a month, including €{car_repairs_total} in garage bills over the last year.

steps.title: Finance an electric car
steps.description: An electric car loan, approved in the app.
steps.why: Based on your own income and spending; no extra documents.
steps.result: Electric car loan pre-approved, ready when you pick the car.

steps.title: Or lease instead of buying
steps.description: A lease with maintenance and tyres included, managed with MoveSmart and VAB.
steps.why: MoveSmart sees your current car and commute, not your income or balances.
steps.result: Lease offer ready to compare with buying.

steps.title: Insure the new car
steps.description: Car insurance (electric car cover where relevant), switched over on the day of delivery.
steps.why: We already know your renewal date.
steps.result: Car insurance ready to start on the delivery date.

steps.title: Charging, tolls and breakdown help
steps.description: VAB fuel and charging cards and vignettes, paid from your KBC account.
steps.why: VAB only needs your name and the car; payments run over your KBC account.

win.customer: Charging sorted before the car arrives

steps.result: Charging card ordered and linked to your account.

steps.title: Or share instead of owning
steps.description: Cambio car sharing for the days you really need a car, combined with train and bus tickets.
steps.why: Cambio only needs your region and how you travel.

win.customer: Pay per trip, not per year

steps.result: Cambio subscription ready to activate, with a comparison of what you would save.
